definitions.explanation: A place designed for bathing, ranging from public bathhouses and hot spring facilities to bathing areas within hotels or ryokan. Can refer to both the building and the bathing area itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{浴場|よくじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a large bathing facility.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浴場|よくじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧{十時|じゅうじ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{利用|りよう}できる→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The hotel's bathing facility can be used until 10 PM.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}→温泉旅館：25209_onsenryokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{露天|ろてん}→露天：14668_roten⟧{浴場|よくじょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧{浴場|よくじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This hot spring inn has both an outdoor bath and an indoor bathing area.

notes:
USAGE:
A general term for any bathing facility. More formal than ⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧ (bath) and broader in scope than ⟦{銭湯|せんとう}→銭湯：16032_sentou⟧ (public bathhouse, specifically a neighborhood pay-bath).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{公衆|こうしゅう}→公衆：11660_koushuu⟧{浴場|よくじょう}: public bathhouse
- ⟦{露天|ろてん}→露天：14668_roten⟧{浴場|よくじょう}: open-air bath
- ⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧{浴場|よくじょう}: indoor bath
- {大|だい}{浴場|よくじょう}: large communal bath (common in hotels and ryokan)
- ⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧{浴場|よくじょう}: communal bathing facility
